children: NMP Acquisition entered into a Business Combination Agreement to merge with GTS in a transaction implying a $400 million enterprise value, creating Pubco as the publicly traded parent. Consideration includes Pubco Class A and high-vote Class B shares and $75 million of Series A preferred, with equity reduced by up to $82 million of retained seller debt. Alongside the deal, the parties executed lock-ups with the seller, sponsor and Maxim, amended the insider letter, and plan to finalize subscription and registration rights amendments and a preferred stock certificate before closing. The package is intended to stabilize trading, align governance and provide capital flexibility post-merger.
